title: Luscious Sweet Fujian Pork Bao
description: A classic Fujian dish featuring tender pork belly in a sweet and savory sauce, wrapped in soft steamed buns. Great for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine pork belly and enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the pork is tender, about 1 hour.
While the pork cooks, combine dark brown sugar, namul blanch seasoning, and 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a small bowl. Mix until the sugar dissolves.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the cooked pork to the pan with the garlic and ginger. Pour in the sugar mixture and stir to coat the pork evenly.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the pork in the sugar sauce for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
To assemble the buns, split each bun in half and place a few pieces of the pork belly on one half. Top with chopped green onions, if using.
Place the other half of the bun on top and serve immediately.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make more buns.
